top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a mature, replicated chain from human incretin physiology (Holst), the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) peptide (Mojsov) and proglucagon-derived peptide and receptor biology (Drucker) to a drug class with established glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal benefit. The trio and the 'made possible' citation keep the prize on discovery while acknowledging the clinical arc. The Habener priority question and Knudsen's exclusion are real caveats but do not outweigh the achievement, so awarding is clearly preferable to no award.
